title: Steps to Avoid Discrimination on Basis of Descent for Primary School Admission
what_it_is: Steps to Avoid Discrimination on Basis of Descent for Primary School Admission

sections.label: Primary 1 admission criteria
sections.summary: The Constitution bars discrimination in national school admission, and P1 selection uses factors like proximity, siblings, alumni and volunteerism, with places reserved for unconnected students.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Constitution provides that there shall be no discrimination against any Singaporean Citizens on the grounds of race, religion, descent and place of birth for the admission of pupils in national schools.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Hence, all our schools are secular and no school will deny the admission of any Singaporean child due to the factors stated in the Constitution.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our Primary 1 admission system seeks to be as open and fair as possible.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: But when the number of students applying to a school exceeds the number of available places, we need a system of selection.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Since there are no examination results to look at for P1 admission, we have to consider other factors.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These include proximity to the school and siblings already in the school, for the convenience of parents and children, children of alumni who have a strong attachment to the school and wish their children to have a similar experience as they did, members of organisations who set up and still legally own the school, active volunteerism in the school or community and students of the MOE Kindergarten in the Primary school.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Admitting students with no prior connections with the school is also an objective, and we reserve places for such students.

sections.label: MOE balancing school accessibility
sections.summary: MOE seeks to strike a balance and, where possible, lean towards making schools more open and accessible to students with no prior connections.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: On our end, MOE seeks to strike a balance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: That is a complicated legacy we live with, but where possible, we will take steps to lean towards making schools more open and accessible to students who have no prior connections with the school.
